notes.title: dig HD Remaster
notes.content:
Dark Codex is thrilled to announce the nonexistent release of "[i]dig[/i] HD Remaster," the definitive version of the classic game that literally nobody clamoured to see in HD. Because what could be better than revisiting a game that's barely aged, with graphics that don’t need any improvement?

[i]dig[/i], a game known for its minimalistic charm, has been 'remastered' in stunning HD. With this release, we promise to deliver exactly the same silhouetted graphics you love, now with an 'HD' tag that changes absolutely nothing about your visual experience!

[b]What’s New in the HD Remaster?[/b]
[list]
[*] Sharper Shovel: Experience the thrill of slightly crisper edges!
[*] Darker Darkness: Revel in the empty night that looks identical to the original!
[/list]
[b]Why release this remaster?[/b] Because if AAA companies can do it, so can we! "[i]dig[/i] HD Remaster" is our contribution to the proud tradition of re-releasing games that aren’t even old yet. Enjoy digging into the same game you've always loved, now with a completely unnecessary HD label! Because at Dark Codex, we believe if it ain’t broke, remaster it anyway!

[b]Disclaimer:[/b] Please note this announcement is satirical. There is no actual "[i]dig [/i]HD Remaster". Happy April Fools' Day!

PS. Please enjoy this totally unnecessary 4k wallpaper!
